posts.title: You Are Allowed to Reject LLMs
posts.description: A lot of people are uncomfortable using LLMs, maybe including you. Or maybe a colleague, relative, or friend has expressed some reservations. That discomfort is amplified when LLMs are increasingly normalized; so much of existing in the world today is “AI this” and “chatbot that” and “agentic everything”.
